messages:
Imani Ford: hi everyone! im Imani (she/they)  just started on Product Ops today. based in Oakland, CA. i bike to work, bring bad jokes, and make a mean mango empanada. excited to meet you all! :bicyclist: :mango: :wave:
Jamal: welcome Imani!! :tada: mango empanadas?? we need a demo asap. lunchtime or after-work hang later this week?
Priya: hey Imani, welcome :heart: im usually around for a quick walk-lunch at 12:30 local. count me in for a taco/empanada tasting.
Nora: welcome!! im in SF  would be down for a short ride with you sometime. also curious: are you fully remote or hybrid?
Imani Ford: hybrid—ill be in the Oakland hub Tue/Thu. would love a bike buddy for the short commuter loop. and yes to empanada demo  i can bring a small batch Fri?
Lina: omg empanadas are a hard yes. friday works for me. :yum: also im in for a 12:30 walk-lunch.
Imani Ford: quick poll—react with :taco: if youd prefer tacos, :empanada: for empanadas, :pizza: for anything/other. or reply with your fav lunch spot. trying to plan Fri pop-up at the hub.
Sam: :taco: (but also will never say no to mango empanadas)
Priya: :empanada:
Nora: :pizza: (i cant be trusted)
Lina: :empanada:
Jamal: :taco:
Imani Ford: great mix! tentative plan: Fri 12:30 hub kitchen  quick intros, taste test, and a 10-min "commute tips" swap for bike folks. ill add calendar invite and a tiny dietary form.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Hub Lunch  Imanis Empanada Demo"  Fri 12:30 local  Invites: Jamal, Priya, Nora, Lina, Sam.
Sam: got it, thanks! :thumbsup:
Jamal: see you Friday. bring the spicy mango version pls :grin:
Imani Ford: spicy mango incoming. also FYI: my WFH comfort level is 90% ambient noise + playlists; if anyone wants my short playlist for focus ill share it in #music-rooms later. thanks for the warm welcome yall!
